## US stock futures ticked higher on Tuesday after the major indexes kicked off the week with solid gains, supported by falling oil prices and a strong rally in heavyweight technology stocks. During Monday's regular session, the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite surged 2.13%, while the S&P 500 and Dow advanced 1.48% and 1.32%, respectively.
